Package sanskrit

Class Interp

java.lang.Object
sanskrit.Interp
public final class Interp extends Object
The interpreter: runs compiled code on a stack machine. One instance holds the global variables, the output sink and the limits of one program.

      public Object callFunction(Object fn, Object[] args, Map<String,Object> kwargs)
